profile.headline: Technology & Operations Leader | Payments, Financial Services & Enterprise Platforms
profile.summary:
Operations and technology leader with 25 years of experience supporting enterprise platforms across payments, financial services, healthcare, SaaS, and telecommunications industries. Proven track record leading teams, improving operational efficiency, implementing scalable systems, and supporting revenue-generating business operations.
Experienced collaborating with executive leadership, business stakeholders, vendors, and engineering teams to deliver complex technology initiatives and operational improvements. Strong background in process automation, systems modernization, financial services workflows, and cross-functional leadership.
Passionate about solving complex operational challenges, mentoring teams, and building scalable, reliable systems that support long-term business growth.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: Apriva Payments is a one-stop payments shop, providing everything needed to accept any payment type, anywhere your business takes you. Apriva is a FinTech company delivering payment solutions to enterprise businesses, ISOs/MSPs, and integrators looking for custom payment solutions. In addition, Apriva is a PCI Level 1 Service provider, Independently validated by VISA®, MasterCard®, American Express®, and the Payment Card Industry Security Standards Council™ (PCI-SSC). Apriva is one of the only P2PE Certified Gateways by a PCI Council Auditor every 2 years.

positions.title: Lead Engineer
positions.description: In this role I am the lead engineer for Recovery and Title Management team.Technologies included .Net, .Net core, SQL, C# and Angular.

positions.title: Lead Engineer
positions.description: In this role I was the lead engineer for the Auto Originations Pricing and Policy team. My responsibilities included working with the 3 credit bureaus, fraud detection, rules, profitability and loss models for Auto Loan Originations.  Technologies included .Net, .Net core, SQL, C#.

positions.title: Integration Architect/Lead
positions.description: In this role I worked directly  with clients to design and build custom privacy solutions. Technologies included Java, Kafka, Kubernetes. SQL.

SQL

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
Design and Developed new High Speed Data Provisioning solution.
Design, Develop and Deploy custom solutions and Java application code
* Develop efficient database processing code using either PL/SQL or T-SQL languages.
* Install, configure, and troubleshoot supported web applications in Development, QA, UA and Production environments.
* Analyze problems in design, configuration, data flow, data state within a highly complex system comprising of interfaces to multiple systems and external B2B vendors in a Weblogic environment.
* Assist with or lead efforts to build new application infrastructure, coordinating efforts across teams as needed while tracking and reporting progress.
* Proactively evaluate application health and performance, follow up on requests and resolve anomalies.

positions.title: System Engineer Commercial Voice
positions.description:
-Responsible for switch engineering and capacity management of the Telephony Infrastructure Commercial Telephone offerings.
- Responsible for assisting with the development and implementation of methods, procedures and practices related to the Commercial Telephony Systems Infrastructure, including switching, pbx’s network engineering and capacity management, disaster recovery, change management, documentation and provisioning.
-Conceptual development, commercial architectural design including features, commercial planning, requirements specification, and analysis of test results of VOIP systems infrastructure.
- Refine and implement systems and engineering requirements for current commercial switch engineering and capacity management as well as provide product and feature specifications for new systems required for commercial VOIP.

positions.title: Project Manager & Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Managed development team of 5 engineers in the design and implementation of an insurance card scanning application, with optical character recognition. (C#, .Net)
•	Managed Test team of 5 engineers for the testing of the of an insurance card scanning application. 
•	Software Development of User Interface for Medical Scanning, Imagining System (C#,  .Net)
•	Software Development of Company Website and Shopping Cart (ASP, .Net)
•	Responsible for software source control for the card scanning application
•	Responsible for tracking problem reports in the card scanning application
•	Responsible for scheduling the development of the card scanning application
•	Responsible for Engineering support for Sales

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer & System Architect
positions.description:
•	Developed Virtual Email Windows Client (C#/.Net 1.1)
•	Developed server side software for the email privacy application (Java/Linux).
•	Prototype privacy software network management solution using Java with an SNMP and JMX solution (Java/Linux).
•	Develop license management software for the email privacy application (Java/SQL/ Linux).
•	Implement and maintain various JSP pages for the client side components in the Virtual email application (HTML/JSP/SOAP/J2EE).
•	Lead development team of ten engineers in the design and implementation of a Virtual email application.
•	Lead development team of ten engineers in the design and implementation of a Virtual credit card application.
•	Participated on architecture team whose responsibility was to design the Identity Theft Solutions 
•	Lead test team of five engineers for the testing of the Identity Theft Solutions. 
•	Wrote functional and technical specification documents for the Identity Theft applications.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•Developed software for VOIP application server/hosted PBX/IP PBX soft switch solution (C++, UNIX, and Windows).
•Developed and maintained MGCP and SCCP phone emulators for automated regression testing of VOIP soft switch solution.
•Prototyped and implemented various signaling protocols to include MEGACO and MGCP for integration into VOIP soft switch product (C++, UNIX, and Windows).
•Prototyped MGCP and SIP Soft Phones for future deployment into VOIP soft switch product offering (C++).
•Acquired intimate knowledge and development experience in live network deployments of VOIP solutions utilizing MGCP, SCCP, MEGACO and SIP protocols (Radvision and Hughes protocol stacks).
•Configured and deployed over 25 Vocaldata soft switch solutions to various partners testing facilities for trial testing.
•Deployed and troubleshot three major carriers’ soft switch solutions using the Vocaldata Soft switch.
